normal.author: Cerevisae
normal.caption_source: 80 year old male came for chest X-ray screening. Normal chest radiograph which is underinspired and is rotated. The entire radiograph image is grainy. The chest X-ray is rotated (the spinous process of the thoracic vertebra is not equidistant between the medial ends of clavicles). The lungs are underinspired (the 7th anterior rib should intersect the right diaphragm instead of 5th anterior rib). Apparent cardiomegaly and the prominent aortic knuckle can be due to the under-inspiration and rotation of the chest radiograph.
